about.title: The Power of Calm
paragraphs: Calm Investments was established in Rotterdam in 2021. We are an independent entrepreneurial investment firm that focuses on acquisitions and participations in small and midsized companies with a leading position in their niche market.

We collaborate based on transparency, integrity and mutual trust. From a team-based culture we invest in leading, niche businesses with differentiated offerings and actively support management in strategy, analytics, operations and M&A.

members.name: Olav van Caldenborgh
members.bio: Olav established Calm Investments in 2021. Prior to that he worked at Caldic, a distributor and manufacturer of specialty chemicals and food ingredients, the last 15 years as CEO. With an entrepreneurial approach he has acquired, integrated and helped more than 20 companies make the next step in their development.
members.personality: Olav is a no-nonsense team player with a well-developed feeling for financials: he translates numbers into the right questions to bring a business forward.

members.name: Jonathan van der Helm
members.bio: Jonathan co-founded Calm Investments in 2021. Before that he worked as a strategy consultant at Roland Berger, completing over 15 projects in growth strategy, restructuring and post-merger integration. He holds an MSc in Offshore Engineering and a BSc in Mechanical Engineering from Delft University of Technology.
members.personality: Jonathan is an analytical enthusiast with a can-do mentality: open-minded, a strong communicator and a well-developed problem solver.
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Jonathan van der Helm

sections.title: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: Calm Investments is an independent entrepreneurial investment firm, located at The Blaak House, Blaak 34, 3011 TA Rotterdam, the Netherlands. Calm Investments is the controller for the personal data processed through this website.
For questions about this privacy statement, please contact us at j.vanderhelm@calminvestments.com or +316-1233 8883.

sections.title: 2. What data we process
paragraphs: Contact form: when you fill in the contact form, we process your name, e-mail address and the content of your message.

Technical data: when you visit the website, limited technical data (such as IP address and browser information) is processed for the secure and correct operation of the website, including spam protection and limiting abuse of the contact form.
Statistics: if you give consent, we process data about your visit (such as pages viewed, visit duration and approximate location) through Google Analytics 4 to analyse how the website is used.

sections.title: 3. Why we use your data
paragraphs: We use the data from the contact form solely to answer your message and get in touch with you. The legal basis is the performance of your request (pre-contractual phase) or our legitimate interest in responding to messages addressed to us.

We process technical data based on our legitimate interest in a secure and well-functioning website. Statistics through Google Analytics are processed solely on the basis of your consent, to improve the website.
We do not use your data for marketing and never sell it to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Processors and recipients
paragraphs: We use the following processors: Resend (Plus Five Five, Inc., United States) for sending and delivering e-mail from the contact form, whereby your name, e-mail address and message are processed through Resend's systems; Cloudflare Turnstile (Cloudflare, Inc.) for spam protection on the form; and Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd.) for website statistics, solely after your consent.

Data processing agreements apply with these parties. Transfers outside the EEA take place on the basis of appropriate safeguards, such as the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses.
We do not otherwise share your data with third parties, unless we are legally required to do so.

sections.title: 5. Retention periods
paragraphs: We keep messages sent through the contact form no longer than necessary to handle your request, and no longer than two years after the last contact, unless a longer retention period is legally required or needed for an ongoing business relationship.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
paragraphs: Functional cookies: this website places a cookie that remembers your language choice (NEXT_LOCALE) and any functional cookies from Cloudflare Turnstile required for spam protection. No consent is required for these functional cookies.

Analytics cookies: we use Google Analytics 4 to measure how the website is used. These cookies are only placed after you have given consent. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time; without consent no analytics cookies are placed.
This website does not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your personal data, the right to restrict processing, the right to data portability and the right to object to processing. To exercise these rights, contact us at j.vanderhelm@calminvestments.com.
If you believe we handle your personal data incorrectly, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority, Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl).

sections.title: 8. Changes
paragraphs: We may amend this privacy statement from time to time. The most recent version is always available on this page, with the date of the last change at the top.

sections.title: 4. Liability

Calm Investments is not liable for damage arising from the use of this website or from its temporary unavailability, except to the extent that such damage results from intent or deliberate recklessness on the part of Calm Investments.

sections.title: 5. Links to third-party websites

sections.title: 6. Applicable law
paragraphs: Dutch law applies to the use of this website and these terms. Disputes will be submitted exclusively to the competent court in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

sections.title: 7. Contact form and e-mail
paragraphs: Messages sent through the contact form are delivered to us by e-mail via our e-mail service provider Resend. Our privacy statement applies to the processing of your personal data in that process. The contact form is protected against abuse and spam with Cloudflare Turnstile.
E-mail communication is not guaranteed to be secure or timely. Do not send confidential or price-sensitive information through the contact form.
